scope: Browser proves the server-owned delivery gate end to end: an ungated session shows a named non-Ready blocker and disables final approval, a fully verified fixture shows Ready and enables approval, and the real approval click passes the delivery gate and completes the session. Evaluator truth-table, stale-decision rejection and the approval/refresh race are proven in supabase/tests/pr_readiness_delivery_gate.sql.

blockedSession.session: seeded final-stage session awaiting review without a canonical PR
blockedSession.readinessLine: PR delivery readiness: unknown (github_observation_missing). Refresh PR verification after resolving it.

readyFixture.session: fixture driven through the real approve/start/publish chain to its final stage with a synchronized canonical PR, one completed authoritative GitHub collection, recorded harness validation evidence for the exact accepted commit, and a current Ready readiness decision
